text:
jordan: Quick sync: we keep hitting mismatched affinity semantics when moving tenants across hosted/dedicated/private. Dropping notes here.

jordan: Issue: router hashing keys != runtime KV affinity -> high cache churn on handoffs.

maria: Can we standardize a minimal affinity contract in the tenant manifest so both sides use the same stable key?

jordan: Proposal: manifest.affinity_mode = [runtime_prefer|router_prefer|balanced], default balanced. Router reads this at handshake.

vikram: Tradeoffs: runtime_prefer lowers latency but risks node hotness; router_prefer evens load but cold caches. We need metrics to monitor: routing_affinity_entropy, kv_miss_rate.

olivia: Short-term: implement router fallback tweak for dedicated targets and clear sticky entries on hosted fallback. Medium-term: RFC for manifest contract + migration plan.

maria: Ops/UI: Console needs a per-tenant affinity indicator and bulk update tooling.

jordan: I'll prototype a replay harness and draft the RFC.

infra-bot: deploy-trigger: staging-affinity-canary started (10% -> 50% -> 100%).
